ashley: @pranav quick ping — PR #8029 is getting repeated CI failures on the windows e2e job, timeout in `test_chat_stream_reconnect`. Can you take a look?
pranav: ah saw the alerts, will investigate. my change touched the reconnect path but i couldn't repro locally yet. failing log shows `TimeoutError: waiting for stream ack` right after kv cache swap.
evAN: i ran 20 loops on my mac w/ docker, hit the same failure once. snippet: ```FAILED tests/test_chat.py::test_chat_stream_reconnect - TimeoutError: waiting for stream ack
2026-02-15T18:22:11.482Z stream.py: ack not received within 5s```
ashley: ugh. can someone kick a rerun while pranav digs in? @ci-bot please rerun pipeline for PR 8029 (windows-e2e). :pray:
ci-bot: ci-bot: Re-run requested by ashley — pipeline 324891 triggered for PR #8029 (job: windows-e2e).
pranav: thanks. i'm going to add a quick defensive backoff + extra log around the ack path and push. if that helps flaky timing we can tighten later.
evAN: small comment — prefer bounded exponential backoff instead of fixed sleep, but for quick unblock a small sleep is fine. also might be worth marking the test flaky while we stabilize. :+1:
lucy: i'll hold merge until green. if the rerun passes i'll approve and merge.
ci-bot: pipeline 324891 (rerun #1) status: failed — windows-e2e timeout in test_chat_stream_reconnect. Logs: `ack wait exceeded`
ashley: thanks for trying the rerun. pranav do you want me to schedule another rerun after your patch lands?
pranav: pushed fix -> branch `pr/8029/ack-backoff` (small change: add capped backoff, additional debug logging). requesting another run.
ci-bot: ci-bot: New pipeline 324912 triggered for PR #8029 (user: pranav) — windows-e2e queued.
ci-bot: pipeline 324912 status: success — windows-e2e all tests passed.
lucy: green, looks good to me. gave :thumbsup: in the PR, approving now.
ashley: thanks everyone — merging after brief wait to let final CI artifacts settle. if we see it again we'll revert or add an explicit flaky marker on the test.
